reviews.text:
One star. Three dogs presented, three months of changing promises, and a frightening outcome.

Delta K9 assessed our home—two small children, three male dogs, two stories and full-time staff—and assured us Ax was perfect. We paid $73,000 for Ax and $5,000 to train our Frenchie, Remy, alongside him. Then they identified aggression toward our other shepherd and said all three dogs needed training. They quoted $8,000, attempted to charge it despite Remy’s existing payment, and ultimately charged another $5,500 instead of honoring the quoted rates.

A promised month became three. Ax reportedly became sick. His replacement, Kobe, arrived with a large nose wound, was described as Level 2, and behaved toward my one-year-old in a way that concerned both me and the trainer. After I emailed the owner, they unexpectedly brought a third dog, Puma, claiming he was worth $100,000 and had been thoroughly tested with Remy.

At home, Puma refused the stairs, feared the backyard, urinated throughout the kitchen and knocked over my toddler while pursuing her dropped toy. Their response included a nighttime crate and unsuccessful attempts to coax him upstairs. Then he bit Remy—the very dog we paid to have trained to prevent this. Remy also returned underweight, prompting our vet to question his feeding, and with a respiratory infection.

We returned Puma. His aggression over toys and what we witnessed as a lack of discernment made us afraid to keep him around our two small children.

Meanwhile, Delta charged $2,111 monthly for food and grooming: $6,333 before we even received a dog. When questioned, they said ownership began at signing—even though they told us Ax was sick and sent back to Germany, without providing veterinary records or proof.

The owner Mike was aggressive, rude and dismissive of any and every concern, making subtle threats like “I don’t want to ruin our professional relationship” any time we had a question or concern.  He yelled at us on the phone when we called to inform him of the bite and to say we don’t trust this dog around our children.

Now they are refusing to refund the money paid and claiming we owe even more. We paid for protection and peace of mind. We ended up fearing for our children and dogs in our own home.

I had a great experience with DELTAK9 especially with the Trainer andy was very professional, always let me reach out any time of the day in regards to my pup. He felt more as a friend someone I could genuinely go to about anything especially with my dog. I wouldn't go to anyone else besides andy. He was the best and the only person i'd trust with my dog.

Andy was our puppy’s trainer, and we couldn’t have been happier with the experience. Each week, he consistently sent us a video update explaining and demonstrating everything our puppy had been learning. It was so rewarding to see her steady progress and the new skills she was gaining each week. We especially loved seeing how in tune she became with Andy—she would attentively wait for his next command and clearly trusted his guidance.

During our carryover training sessions, Andy created an encouraging and supportive environment where we could practice giving commands and learn what to expect. He provided constructive feedback, along with immediate solutions and helpful guidance whenever we needed it. He was also incredibly down-to-earth, patient, and easy to work with.

Overall, we felt completely confident knowing our puppy was in such great hands. Andy did an amazing job, and we’re so grateful for all the care, guidance, and training he provided!

This is the first time I've ever paid for dog training in my life. All my other dogs I trained myself, but now I can't devote the time.

I adopted a new dog from the pound, and immediately it was clear she needed training. She was hindering my sales calls and I needed to have her taken away and trained ASAP. I searched around for someone who could take her that day.

I found Delta K9 and on a Sunday met with the owner and head trainer Mike. He assessed Kira, said they would be able to take her that day, and they would work primarily on leash work, and general commands like sit, stay, place, and heel.

I paid them $5k and they said it would take 3-4 weeks. Kira ended up needing a little longer and they had her for a total of 5.5 weeks and didn't charge me any additional money.

They sent me weekly video updates on her progress. Andy, her trainer, and I just had the first of our 3 integration trainings. You need to go spend time with them in person 3 times before you take your dog home so they can train you on what they trained them. Andy also said he would be able to meet me in my home for the 3rd and final integration session so he can introduce her to my cats. He didn't have to offer that and I am very impressed. With the quality of service I have received. We lived near each other and so I wouldn’t assume this is standard. But if you’re cool with the trainers they may for you.

The front desk women Marium and Adel have been extremely helpful whenever I have a question and are very responsive. During business hours I usually received a reply within 2 hours.

I would highly recommend you to have your dog trained here. I'm going to return in a month or so, so that they can do e-collar training.

Be aware that if paying by card there is a 4% surcharge that goes to pay for their credit card processing. I don't know if they accept checks but they do Venmo and other cash payments like that.

GRACE at Delta K9 completely changed my life with my Belgian Malinois, Apollo.

Before training, Apollo was not very sociable and honestly I did not know what to expect after his behavioral modification training. I picked him up on March 26th during one of the hardest and most stressful times of my year,  tax season! This is where I regularly work 10+ hour days seeing clients in my office.

I was nervous because Apollo comes with me everywhere, and I truly did not know how he would adapt around people, clients, long office days in a crate, and daily life.

What Grace did with Apollo at Delta K9 was an absolute game changer!!!!

The transformation in his obedience, calmness, focus, confidence, and overall behavior was incredible. She not only helped Apollo tremendously, but also helped me better understand my dog and become a better handler myself.

Grace has an unbelievable understanding of working dogs and canine behavior. You can tell immediately that she genuinely cares about the dogs she works with and puts her heart into what she does.

Apollo is family to me, and because of Grace at Delta K9, I now feel confident bringing him with me into my everyday life, even during the busiest time of the year. Clients were in awe when they figured out I had a dog in a crate and how incredible he was. I can honestly say he barked at maybe 3 clients out of couple hundred!!!! Yeah most def a game changer! So much confidence built.

I truly cannot thank her enough. If you are serious about your dog, especially high-drive breeds like a Malinois,  I would trust Grace at Delta K9 without hesitation.

Absolutely life changing experience and I am eternally grateful to have met her!

I have been telling everyone about Delta K9, that’s how well my experience was with the company. Great communication and the trainers addressed things I was doing wrong as a handler after my GSD finished his board and train program. Owner and staff are very passionate about what they do and it was evident from the results I got.

Delta K9 Academy is top-notch when it comes to dog training. The trainers are experienced, patient, and clearly know how to handle different behaviors. I saw real improvement in my dog’s obedience and confidence. Highly recommend for anyone serious about training their dog the right way.

I brought my dog to Delta K9 for training due to reactivity. He made amazing progress while there with his trainer Grace. She was phenomenal and provided great updates on his progress. My dog completed the basic obedience training and e-collar training. Delta K9 and Grace took great care of him. At the completion of his training his reactivity had improved greatly and they help me gain the knowledge to handle future situations. I highly recommend using Delta K9 for training your dog. They are welcoming of any dog regardless of where they are in their training.

I am at loss for words ! This place is amazing and cannot begin to explain how grateful we are. Thank you so much Andy for the lessons that you have given to Bruce and myself as well! After 6weeks of training he is such a good and well behaved good boy! I ensure to keep the tips and tricks to make sure my dog is at its best!! If I have to recommend this place I 10000% would and will!! Thank you so much Andy and everyone at Delta K9 !!!

Delta K9 Academy exceeded every expectation I had. From the facility itself to the structure, professionalism, and overall care, everything was truly exceptional.

My dog Boba completed an obedience board and train with Grace, and I am beyond grateful for her. Grace was patient, knowledgeable, and incredibly attentive to Boba’s individual needs. Throughout the entire program, she consistently sent videos and pictures to keep me updated, which gave me so much peace of mind and allowed me to see Boba’s progress in real time.

Before training, Boba was showing clear signs of aggression and reactivity. After her time at Delta K9, she is now able to walk calmly in front of other dogs and handle situations that once felt impossible.

I would highly recommend Delta K9 Academy to anyone looking for real results, exceptional trainers, and a facility that genuinely cares about the dogs they work with.
After 3 excuses still no trainer. They will charge if you cancel but love canceling on you.

Our dog boarded at Delta K9 for 3 nights for his first time being away from home. We saw this business on Instagram and thought this would be perfect as we are aware he can get aggressive towards people and dogs out of anxiety. Despite very good reviews for their training, we believe the boarding was not satisfactory. With our dog having anxiety and a big fear of dogs and people, we were looking forward to a comforting boarding experience for our scared two year old dog as we had booked the second best room with daily video updates and their own aggressive dog handler. Upon drop off, we were not able to see the room in person and were told we would receive our first video promptly to ease our nerves and actually be able to see where he will be staying. Hours go by and no video was sent. After emailing, calling, and dming for 2 days, we were finally able to reach them by phone and were told that we haven’t received a video because our dog is too aggressive. Isn’t this K9 academy specifically for aggressive dogs? The website specifically states there is no dog they cannot handle. We paid for the second best room that comes with an aggressive dog handler that should specialize in these kind of dogs. It felt as we were being faulted for them not sending the promised videos because of our dog which is very confusing as again, we booked this room because we knew he’d be with professionals. If he was too aggressive, why did we have to reach out multiple times to be told this information where they should’ve communicated this to us in the first place. We received a video on the 3rd day of him walking outside (hair standing up on his back and very nervous, looking as if it was his first time out in the play area) and then another with him in his room from the outside of the glass door. Couldn’t we have gotten a video of him through the glass door the first or second day if he was being aggressive to the handlers outside of the room? To add, the room is extremely small with one bed and a water bowl (didn’t see the toys we brought him in the video and no blankets were allowed) Overall,  there was a extreme lack of communication and unprofessionalism when it came to ensuring we felt that our dog was cared for. There was no reassurance to know that the dogs felt safe and comfortable especially since you can’t see inside and all you hear is constant barking (of course we understand this is a dog training facility and there will be loud noise but that being the only impression and accessible place for owners is unsettling) Please do not promote that your business can handle all dogs and make us pay for a special room specifically for aggressive dogs if you cannot take proper care and fulfill all of the promises listed on your website. Unfortunately, we won’t be returning
Amazing!

Our Rottweiler received care, dedication and top knotch obedience training from Grace! We are very grateful for the relationship that was built between our family and Grace. We really appreciated the videos that were shared to see how the training was going.
Our dog has been transformed and is listening, and easier to have at home with our family. We highly recommend you train, board or both at Delta K9.
The facility is clean, and the staff are knowledgeable, attentive and helpful. Our dog is in great shape and very muscular since the obedience training. We are proud and more confident in every day care, grooming and in taking our dog out on walks in our neighborhood since the training.
Thank you for your kindness and assistance with our dog.

I can’t recommend Delta K9 Academy enough! From the moment we started, it was clear they truly understand dogs and how to bring out the best in them. The trainers are knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely care about both the dogs and their owners. Na’na has learned so much and I see improvements every single day. Perfect experience from start to finish, if you want a happy, well-trained dog, this is the place!

If you’re thinking about using them, I wouldn’t think any longer. Delta K9 took in our pup while we were at a friend’s wedding and they did a fantastic job with our first timer, and with us. Even though we were only away for 4 days, they went out of there was to provide us with a little video update, which really goes a long way. Especially if you’re someone who’s ever had a bad experience with kennels. Everyone was very kind, even when I showed up for a surprise site visit. They took me around their facility and answered every little question I had. By the time I walked out, I was convinced. When we got him back he was freshly washed and brushed, and excited to go home :)

It would’ve been nice to get a little more insight on his behavior during his stay. We paid for human aggression because we have a rescue who reacts to new people trying to pet him in our house, but we rarely get to see how acts outside of our care, so it would’ve been invaluable insight to receive from the trainers that were handling him. (Probably should’ve mentioned we were in the market for training 😆)

All that said, I’ll definitely be using them again for the next excursion we can’t bring our furry boy on. Thanks a bunch guys! (I’ll be back for my Famers Dog dish someday soon! lol)
Top notch, training quality facility and extremely good instructors

I was at the Delta K9 Academy for an evaluation of my puppy to see which level of personal protection dog training was appropriate. Mike was rude; he kicked me out just because I said that four sessions of training for $600 is too much, especially the level 2 personal protection dog training costs $35,000 and level 3 personal protection dog training costs $75,000. I would have to leave my dog there for four weeks for an obedience board and training first before starting personal protection dog training at level 2 or 3. In the back of my head, I remembered the negative reviews about Delta K9 Academy abusing dogs and dumping dogs that couldn't be trained left in the heat to die. I told him I didn't want to leave my dog at Delta K9 academy for four weeks, especially since the price is too high. He seemed to get angry and had no patience with me, and he got mad at a woman who was working at Delta k9 academy. She was scared; I forgot her name, she was super nice and helpful me and my puppy. However, Mike's behavior speaks volumes on it's own about what he has been doing behind closed doors... Crazy work.
My dog loved her trainer.

My Maltipoo was trained and boarded by Delta K9 Academy. They did an amazing job training him. Prior to his training, we were concerned with some aggression and anxiety we saw in our dog. They have really worked to ease our dog’s anxiety. He also knows several commands! We no longer have to worry about taking him out in public or being around people he doesn’t know. We’re very grateful for Delta’s professionalism, constant communication and the love they had for our dog. Highly recommend!
Perfect trainers always explaining every step of the way and updating you, thanks Vince dawg !

I cannot thank Delta K9 enough! I started off so worried about my 17-month-old Presa Canario. He wouldn’t listen, and anytime he was corrected, he would often growl with aggression. Being 6 months pregnant, I was really scared that he was a lost cause.

Grace worked with him for 8 weeks, including e-collar training, and I was absolutely shocked when I saw the results. He listens, goes to place, walks calmly with a stroller, and goes right into his kennel. The difference is night and day!

We are beyond grateful to Grace and Delta K9 for giving us the tools to enjoy our boy and feel confident bringing him into our growing family. Highly recommend!

I had a fantastic experience with Delta, thanks especially to Grace, who did an incredible job training my dog. She was patient, knowledgeable, and truly went above and beyond to make sure both my dog and I felt confident throughout the process. Thank you!
Great place to train your dogs! Our trainer Grace was amazing and we are very pleased with how everything went! We see so much improvement with the obedience training. Thank you Delta K9 Academy!

I can’t express how great my experience here has been. On my consultation appointment Mike gave me some great insight on how I could help my pup Atlas with his socialization before he came in for training ( he was too young). The puppy I dropped off was scared of new people and wanted to hide behind me all the time. The dog i received back has more confidence than I thought would be possible in 6 weeks. The bond that trainer Grace built with my boy brought him out of his shell and on his way to being an amazing and well rounded dog. Obviously work has to continue at home but Delta K9 has given us the foundation and tools to succeed with his training.
You are the best and I’m very happy

Grace at DeltaK9 Academy did an amazing job with obedience training for our Swiss Shepherd—our dog is like a new person! Grace is patient, knowledgeable, and truly cares about your dog’s progress. Mike, the owner, runs a professional, welcoming facility. Highly recommend if you want real results with your dog.

Every person we encountered was extremely friendly, courteous and helpful. We like the philosophy of Delta K9 Academy. We learned a great deal of information that helped us to choose to become lifelong students in order to ensure the enduring success of our dog's behavior.
We thank Mike for matching us well based on our specific needs with our trainer, Grace. She is impeccable! Our rating is determined by how our dog responds to those around him. He is happy, well cared for and very well trained. The added bonus.Is that my husband and I are happy too.
I came here because my dog had behavioral issues and I needed help. I’m super happy with the results! Grace is an amazing person and trainer. So grateful for deltak9 but more grateful for Grace!

Waste of money , they didn’t even give my dog the food I brought for him, they had him for 4 weeks and he hasn’t changed any as far as his training. Also gurgles when he’s breathing like his neck is hurt or something, I have to take him to the vet. 5,000 dollars down the drain!    So an update on this , my dogs neck was injured , he also had kennel croop , I told delta about this and they said send them the vet bill and they pay even though keep in MJ d my dog is not even a bit better then when I dropped him off and paid 5090 dollars now they won’t answer back and today they finally did and said they are not Oahu g it nand they don’t care about my record I’m a nobody and they have a reputation. So best of luck if you dare take your dog to this concentration camp and I suggest  you look at where and how your dog is kept and how often it leaves its cage because they portray differently. Hey I’m sitting here at vet we weee just talking about the kennel croup my dog got from there that you promised to pay for then never did because that’s how you operate and you room my dogs food food I brought and gave him cheap stuff . Such crooks and poor conditions for the animals, did you want me to grab the paperwork again while I’m here and send to you again or just have my lawyer send it? It’s up to you….

I can’t say enough about Delta K9 Academy.  They are a stellar organization.  The trainers and staff are very friendly and excel with the dogs.  Our German Shepherd went through the obedience training, and it was an excellent experience for both us and our dog.

Located in Valley Glen, one of the initial draws was that they were close to our home; however, now that I know how great they are, I would be willing to travel much further.  This organization is five out of five stars.  If you’re looking for training, this is the place to be.

I have been following Delta K9 Academy for sometime now and finally got the courage to call them up and make an appointment to take my 2 year old golden doodle for Obedience training. Mike and his team are very professional.
Maryam his receptionist is amazing she made sure all of my questions are answered and always keeps me posted regarding my girls progress.
Vahe our trainer is the best has a lot of patience with our dog that has very bad separation anxiety, jumping on people, and begging for food he is able to dramatically change her.
So thankful for them and happy that she will be coming home soon and will be better companion rather than us yelling at her all the time. I will recommend Delta K9 to anyone who is looking for any king of training or boarding.

Just got my 10 month old dobie back after she completed her obedience training. The difference is night and day!! She’s so well behaved and all of her behaviors I wanted to address were addressed. I highly recommend them. I will definitely be boarding her again with them :)
I know my  aggressive and hyper German shepherd is in good hands whenever he goes to delta k9. Huge shout out to the dog Hotel staff

Mike is a bully. As I was trying to work with them regarding the refund of vet bills for my dog’s kennel cough, they asked that I email the vet bills and I did! No response from any of them. I finally called after a month and I was told “you want me to pay for your dogs vet bills?” I said you should, my dog lost weight, got a kennel cough and didn’t train well after being in your facility for almost a month! Not to mention us paying 5k for his training! We didn’t pay 5k just to deal with the aftermath!

Brought our high anxiety 6 year old Sheppard in for the 5 step program and his dog reactivity on leash has dramatically improved. Moreover, the techniques we learned have helped build a stronger relationship between us and our dog, and helped us establish ourselves as pack leaders. Stefano pointed out traits and mannerisms that my wife and I had that were causing additional anxiety or misbehavior in our dog. We are so thankful for all the guidance Stefano has provided.

Boarded my dog here who is human aggressive with a bite history. He's a 96lb pitbull so he's not the smallest dog. They were AMAZING. I opted in for the daily video updates and it truly took any anxiety I had away. It was so nice to be on vacation and see that he was doing good and being treated so sweetly. Drop off and pick up were extremely easy and you could tell they were so comfortable handling any type of dog and knew exactly what they were doing. I will 1000% be using them again. Also any person I interacted with there was extremely nice and respectful. I have ZERO bad things to say about them. Thanks for watching over my baby!

I just wanna say on of the trainers Grace was amazing transformed my dog into a great dog listens to every command, A dog who once wanted to bite everyone turned into a dog who is unbothered and loves everyone, What Grace has done for us is unbelievable. If Grace is training your dog your in safe hands and she generous enough to run you down on how to condition the dog at home

A. They love dogs!
B. They talk to them!.
C. Even though they are kind of pricy, they can make a dog out of the wolf!!! …

We love Delta K9 Academy!!! I sent my dog, Klaus, to their training boot camp and when I picked him up he was a brand new dog. He learned so many new commands that made it easy for me to manage him throughout the toughest parts of his …

Mike and his staff are awesome and professional.
As a working dog expert , I strongly recommend Delta k9 for all your dog training  needs. Also you can find well breed puppies in this facility.
Great Facility! They took incredible care of my dog, it's simply the best place to board your loved pet.
